lines.text: The disciples ask where to prepare the Passover, and Jesus sends them into the city to a certain man's house.
At evening Jesus says one of the twelve will betray Him, the one who dipped his hand into the basket.
Judas asks, "Surely not I, Rabbi?" and Jesus answers, "You have said it yourself."
Jesus gives bread as His body and the cup as His blood, then they go to the Mount of Olives.
Jesus says all will fall away and He will go ahead into Samaria, and Peter will deny Him.
